name: Falou (OpusBR)

runner.notes: Install Falou for Mac, authenticate, connect or use built-in access to coding CLIs (Claude Code, Codex, and others listed in product copy), open only runs/<run-id>/worktree as the project, delegate prompt.md via voice/text or Agent Board / Squads mission, then harness-verify after work lands on the prepared tree. Record Falou version, guest agent/model, mission mode, and interventions. macOS only for the current download surface.

inclusion: Direct Class A multi-agent ADE-adjacent control plane: Mac notch assistant that runs coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, OpenCode, Grok CLI, Antigravity, Verboo), Agent Board kanban, Squads with isolated project copies, and task-first delegation—beyond pure voice dictation.
pricing_model: Official marketing describes local offline dictation as free/unlimited; cloud agent and plan packaging beyond free BYOK (Claude Code/Codex on the user's own accounts) were not fully price-tabled in the reviewed SPA copy—record plan/limits at install time.
public_stack_signals: Hosted under OpusBR domain falou.opusbr.com as a macOS product (Windows waitlist mentioned in SPA).
Voice-first notch UI plus Modo Agente and Modo Ditado.
Native coding-agent sessions for Claude Code and Codex from the notch; @ selects agent and local project.
Agent Board kanban (Backlog → Review → Active → Done) where dragging a card is the action.
Squads/missions: parallel agents on isolated project copies with verification and merge to one branch.
